papers.headline: Optimal galaxy magnification: generalized fundamental-plane residuals and number counts are all you need
papers.summary: Weak-lensing magnification complements cosmic shear through its effects on galaxy fluxes, sizes, and number counts.
papers.title: Optimal galaxy magnification: generalized fundamental-plane residuals and number counts are all you need

papers.headline: Predictions for an unseen third planet in the WISPIT 2 system
papers.summary: We predict the mass and semi-major axis of a currently unseen but hypothesised planet in the WISPIT 2 system based on the location of the ring observed by ALMA at 144.4 au.
papers.title: Predictions for an unseen third planet in the WISPIT 2 system

papers.headline: Modeling MAD Sgr A* flares and their dependence on spin
papers.summary: Aims: This study aims to place constraints on the spin of Sgr A* from recent flare observations.
papers.title: Modeling MAD Sgr A* flares and their dependence on spin
